purpose: Accumulate immutable new PIT earnings expectations, stock money flow and industry-prosperity revisions without reusing seen 2019-2025 outcomes.
rules: Observe only the current Shanghai date; historical backfill and same-date recapture are forbidden.
Fetch sources independently, preserve partial success, and make no automatic retry after a source failure.
Collapse only identical full provider records across pages; conflicting duplicates fail closed.
Derive forecast revisions and industry breadth only from two or more prospectively witnessed snapshots.
Require at least 20 distinct prospective observations and matured labels before any pre-registered model experiment.
Never read returns or labels, tune a model, change the V6 incumbent, authorize execution, or claim prediction readiness.
